package.name: astral_web_monitor
package.description: Non-intrusive Web UI monitor for the astral_ws teleop stack. Subscribes to existing joint topics (read-only), publishes only to the existing /teleop/armed and /teleop/disarm control topics for pause/resume, and orchestrates ros2 launch via subprocess for start/stop. Serves a React SPA over FastAPI + WebSocket on port 8080.
